mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'income' THEN amount ELSE -amount END), 0) FROM `transaction` WHERE book_id = #{bookId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `transaction` WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'income' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'expense' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expense FROM `transaction` WHERE book_id = #{bookId} AND deleted = 0 AND (#{startDate,jdbcType=DATE} IS NULL OR trans_date >= #{startDate,jdbcType=DATE}) AND (#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} IS NULL OR trans_date <= #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE})

SELECT t.category_id AS category_id, COALESCE(c.name, '已删除分类') AS category_name, COALESCE(c.icon, 'other') AS category_icon, COALESCE(c.color, 'gray') AS category_color, SUM(t.amount) AS amount FROM `transaction` t LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = t.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE t.book_id = #{bookId} AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.type = #{type} AND (#{startDate,jdbcType=DATE} IS NULL OR t.trans_date >= #{startDate,jdbcType=DATE}) AND (#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} IS NULL OR t.trans_date <= #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE}) GROUP BY t.category_id, c.name, c.icon, c.color ORDER BY amount DESC, t.category_id
mapper.sql: WITH running AS (SELECT t.id, t.trans_date, t.type, t.amount, t.note, COALESCE(c.name, '已删除分类') AS category_name, COALESCE(c.icon, 'other') AS category_icon, COALESCE(c.color, 'gray') AS category_color, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'income' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END) OVER (ORDER BY t.trans_date, t.id) AS balance_after FROM `transaction` t LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = t.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE t.book_id = #{bookId} AND t.deleted = 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id, trans_date, type, amount, note, category_name, category_icon, category_color, balance_after FROM running WHERE (#{startDate,jdbcType=DATE} IS NULL OR trans_date >= #{startDate,jdbcType=DATE}) AND (#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} IS NULL OR trans_date <= #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE}) ORDER BY trans_date ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, trans_date, type, amount, note, category_name, category_icon, category_color, balance_after FROM running WHERE DATE_FORMAT(trans_date, '%Y-%m') = #{month} ORDER BY trans_date ASC, id ASC
